# findmnt -rn -b --raw -o SOURCE,TARGET,FSTYPE,USED,AVAIL,USE%,OPTIONS,PARTUUID,UUID,LABEL,PARTLABEL
#
# Synthetic, and deliberately awkward:
#   - five btrfs subvolumes of ONE device (one PARTUUID) that must collapse to
#     one HD alert while staying five detail rows,
#   - a mountpoint whose space arrives escaped as \x20,
#   - a device whose every identity column is empty, so the positional split has
#     to keep the empty fields rather than slide the columns left,
#   - a volume label that tries to close the untrusted-data block and write an
#     instruction,
#   - a read-only NTFS models partition,
#   - a tmpfs that must never draw a ring even though it is configured.
